title: ECS metadata

fields.name: add
fields.description: Similar to the add option in the [modify filter](/manual/4.2/data-pipeline/filters/modify.md).

fields.name: agent_endpoint_retries
fields.description: Number of retries for failed metadata requests to the ECS Agent Introspection endpoint.

fields.name: cluster_metadata_only
fields.description: When enabled, the plugin only attempts to attach cluster metadata values.

fields.name: ecs_meta_cache_ttl
fields.description: The filter builds a hash table in memory mapping each unique container short ID to its metadata.

fields.name: ecs_meta_host
fields.description: The host name at which the ECS Agent Introspection endpoint is reachable.

fields.name: ecs_meta_port
fields.description: The port at which the ECS Agent Introspection endpoint is reachable.

fields.name: ecs_tag_prefix
fields.description: Similar to the kube_tag_prefix option in the [Kubernetes filter](/manual/4.2/data-pipeline/filters/kubernetes.md) and performs the same function.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit filter plugin: ECS metadata.
